steps.label: Apply product
steps.instruction: Clearly show enough alcohol handrub entering a cupped palm to cover both hands.

pose_signature.hand_orientation: One open cupped palm receives product from a dispenser or the other hand.
pose_signature.motion_pattern: Product is visibly dispensed into the palm.
pose_signature.distinguishing_cue: Visible product application; rubbing gestures alone are not this step.

steps.label: Palm to palm
steps.instruction: Rub both palms together with visible back-and-forth motion.

pose_signature.hand_orientation: Both open palms face and contact each other.
pose_signature.motion_pattern: Back-and-forth rubbing with fingers aligned rather than threaded.
pose_signature.distinguishing_cue: Neither hand dorsum is used as the rubbing surface and fingers are not interlaced.

steps.label: Palm over dorsum
steps.instruction: Rub one palm over the back of the other hand with fingers interlaced, then repeat on the other side.

pose_signature.hand_orientation: One open palm lies on the dorsum of the other hand; hands are stacked palm-to-back.
pose_signature.motion_pattern: Back-and-forth rubbing over each hand dorsum, reversing sides.
pose_signature.distinguishing_cue: A hand dorsum is clearly the rubbing surface; this is not palm-to-palm interlacing.

steps.label: Fingers interlaced
steps.instruction: Rub palm to palm with fingers interlaced.

pose_signature.hand_orientation: Both palms face each other while the fingers are threaded between the opposite fingers.
pose_signature.motion_pattern: Back-and-forth rubbing through the finger spaces.
pose_signature.distinguishing_cue: Fingers remain straight and interlaced palm-to-palm; no hand dorsum or bent knuckles are rubbed.

steps.label: Backs of fingers
steps.instruction: Rub the backs of bent fingers against the opposing palm on both sides.

pose_signature.hand_orientation: The backs of folded fingers or knuckles press into the opposite palm.
pose_signature.motion_pattern: Side-to-side or rotational rubbing of bent finger backs, reversing sides.
pose_signature.distinguishing_cue: Bent or folded fingers are mandatory; straight interlaced fingers belong to another step.

steps.label: Thumb rubbing
steps.instruction: Rotationally rub each thumb while clasped by the opposite palm.

pose_signature.hand_orientation: One opposite palm fully clasps a single protruding thumb.
pose_signature.motion_pattern: Rotational rubbing around one thumb, then the other.
pose_signature.distinguishing_cue: A single thumb is visibly encircled; this is not fingertip or wrist rubbing.

steps.label: Fingertips in palm
steps.instruction: Rotationally rub fingertips in the opposite palm on both sides.

pose_signature.hand_orientation: Gathered fingertips of one hand press into the center of the opposite open palm.
pose_signature.motion_pattern: Rotational rubbing of fingertip pads in each palm.
pose_signature.distinguishing_cue: Several fingertips contact the palm together; no single thumb or wrist is encircled.

steps.label: Wrist rubbing
steps.instruction: Rotationally rub each wrist with the opposite hand.

pose_signature.hand_orientation: One hand encircles the opposite wrist below the heel of the hand.
pose_signature.motion_pattern: Rotational rubbing around one wrist, then the other.
pose_signature.distinguishing_cue: Contact is below the hand at the wrist; this is not a clasped thumb or fingertips pressing into a palm.
